remarks: FINAL AND BEST DEADLINE BY MONDAY, 6/9 AT 12PM. It's not easy to find a turnkey home in this price point here in Westport. This one checks all the boxes. Thoughtfully renovated and meticulously maintained, this stylish home features a chef's kitchen with a Brazilian Danby marble island, custom cabinetry, and quality finishes throughout. The 2.5 updated baths blend timeless design with modern functionality. Major improvements completed in recent years include roof, windows, siding, electrical, plumbing, HVAC system, and more-offering peace of mind and lasting value. The professionally landscaped yard includes two beautiful bluestone patios, a full irrigation system, and a fully fenced, level yard, perfect for entertaining or relaxing outdoors. Additional features include a whole-house generator and a location that's hard to beat-close to town, schools, beaches, and commuter routes. A perfect combination of comfort, style, and convenience in the heart of Westport.
